verdict.rationale: Phaser is scripted directly in JavaScript or TypeScript, the language the engine itself exposes. Docs show the core API used straight from code (`this.add.sprite`, scenes, physics, the loader, animations), and full TypeScript definitions are picked up automatically by editors like VSCode. Phaser Editor adds a code editor with IntelliSense, and several community reports say it is easy to learn and quick to build with. However, nothing in the evidence documents a debugger, and one community post calls the TypeScript experience 'best effort'. Missing for 10: any documented debugger or debugging workflow, stronger independent confirmation that the TypeScript typings cover the full API.
